test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Lucy presented a __lucid __account of her achievements before the committee.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ambiguous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lucid **means clear and easily understood. (स्पष्ट और आसानी से समझा जाने वाला)

 
 
• **For example- ***Write in a clear and lucid style.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Ambiguous **means unclear or vague. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **For example- ***It was an ambiguous sentence that could be taken in two ways.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym for the underlined word in the sentence is 'ambiguous'.

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Orderly **means neat and well-organized, which is not the opposite of 'lucid'. (साफ़ सुथरा और सुव्यवस्थित)
 
• **Intelligible **means understandable, which is actually a synonym of 'lucid'. (बोधगम्य)
 
• **Transparent **means clear or easy to see through, which is not the opposite of 'lucid'. (स्पष्ट या देखने में आसान)
